items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

ctx.x: Yeah, my buddy. Eddie Johnson. Let me see. But, uh... But, uh... As soon as the last piano player, I'm trying to think now. I had so many. I just can't remember. Mostly with it. Yeah, yeah. Mostly with it on piano. Mostly with it.
Celestan always liked to have a woman on piano. I don't know why.
